conversations_shape.name: conversations_shape
conversations_shape.value:
("conversations"."kind" = 'dm' and "conversations"."dm_user_low" is not null and "conversations"."dm_user_high" is not null and "conversations"."dm_user_low" < "conversations"."dm_user_high" and "conversations"."help_request_id" is null)
        or ("conversations"."kind" = 'mentor' and "conversations"."help_request_id" is not null and "conversations"."dm_user_low" is null and "conversations"."dm_user_high" is null)

help_requests_claim_shape.name: help_requests_claim_shape
help_requests_claim_shape.value: ("help_requests"."status" = 'open' and "help_requests"."mentor_id" is null) or ("help_requests"."status" <> 'open' and "help_requests"."mentor_id" is not null)
